name: Remote
description_en:
Remote is a global employment platform with separate Global Payroll, Employer of Record, US PEO and contractor products. Global Payroll is positioned for countries where the customer owns an entity; EOR supplies an employment route where it does not.

Its documented payroll workflow covers inputs, local gross-to-net calculations, variances, approvals, statutory remittance, payment and reporting. Service prices, employer responsibilities, conditional reserves, currency conversion and contractor risk coverage need to be read by product rather than collapsed into one universal rate.
description_zh:
Remote 是全球雇佣平台，提供不同的 Global Payroll、名义雇主、美国 PEO 及承包人员产品。Global Payroll 定位客户已有实体的国家，EOR 则用于没有自有实体的雇佣安排。

文档工资流程涵盖输入、本地税前到实发、差异、批准、法定缴款、付款及报表。需按产品理解服务价格、雇主责任、条件准备金、汇率和承包人员风险保障，不能合并成统一费率。

core_features.explanation_en: The payroll page describes local calculations, cutoff/off-cycle calendars, variance and exception review before approval, statutory remittances and reports.
core_features.explanation_zh: 工资页描述本地计算、截止及额外工资日历、批准前差异异常检查、法定缴款及报表。

core_features.explanation_en: Global Payroll uses customer entities; EOR employs through Remote; US PEO and contractor products have separate scope and prices.
core_features.explanation_zh: Global Payroll 使用客户实体，EOR 由 Remote 雇佣，美国 PEO 和承包产品另有范围价格。

core_features.explanation_en: Vendor documentation names HRIS/finance connections and GL exports, with reporting by country, entity and cost center.
core_features.explanation_zh: 供应商文档列出 HRIS 财务连接及总账导出，按国家、实体和成本中心报表。

pricing.summary_en: Starting monthly service fees: Payroll $29/employee, EOR $599, US PEO $99; active contractor Management $29, Plus $99, COR $325. No standard setup/base fees; conditional reserve and FX need review.
pricing.summary_zh: 月度服务起价：工资人均$29、EOR$599、美国PEO$99；活跃承包人员Management$29、Plus$99、COR$325。无标准设置基础费，但需核对条件准备金及汇率。

official_check.scope: Public primary sources read; no account, purchase, integration execution, performance benchmark, owner identity or publication approval tested.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Choose the employer relationship before the fee
sections.title_zh: 先选雇主关系，再比较费用
sections.en: The pricing page distinguishes Global Payroll for customer-owned entities from EOR for countries without one. The payroll FAQ’s statement that an entity is not always required refers to the EOR alternative, not proof that Global Payroll alone replaces the legal employer. US PEO is separately described for US teams and requires a US bank account, with USD billing explicitly stated for that product. Contractor Management keeps the contract with the customer, while Contractor of Record places it with Remote. Confirm worker classification, country eligibility and responsibilities before selecting a service; no arrangement was legally assessed here.
sections.zh: 价格页区分客户自有实体使用 Global Payroll、无实体国家使用 EOR。工资 FAQ 称不总需要实体，指的是 EOR 替代，并非 Global Payroll 本身代替法律雇主。美国 PEO 单独面向美国团队，明确要求美国银行账户并以美元计费。Contractor Management 的合同由客户持有，Contractor of Record 则由 Remote 持有。选择前需确认人员分类、国家资格及责任，本研究没有法律评估任何安排。

sections.en: The Global Payroll page describes one workflow for prepare, review, approve, pay and report, with local gross-to-net, off-cycle runs and cutoff calendars. It names variance and exception checks, time/expense synchronization, statutory deductions and GL exports. An illustrative parallel cycle should include one changed salary and one late expense, then reconcile inputs, calculations, liabilities, payslip, funding and ledger result. A payment preview or audit-ready log is not independent proof of settlement or legal correctness. Exact cutoff handling, rejection recovery and integration direction require a configured demonstration.
sections.zh: Global Payroll 页描述准备、审核、批准、付款和报表的统一流程，包括本地税前到实发、额外工资及截止日历，并提到差异异常、工时费用同步、法定扣款和总账导出。并行示例可包含调薪及迟交费用，再核对输入、计算、负债、工资单、资金及总账。付款预览或审计日志不能独立证明结算或法律正确性。具体截止处理、拒付恢复及集成方向需配置演示。

sections.title_en: Different service fees exclude different work
sections.title_zh: 不同服务费对应不同工作
sections.en: The current pricing page lists starting amounts per employee monthly of $29 for Global Payroll, $599 for EOR and $99 for US PEO. Contractor Management starts at $29 per active contractor monthly, Management Plus $99 and Contractor of Record $325. These are starting service prices, not employee salary, tax or benefit budgets. Global Payroll, EOR and Management state the Remote Platform is included without a base fee; the FAQ says no setup or onboarding fees. Country, selected service, optional benefits and actual invoice currency still need quotation. Two employees at the published Global Payroll starting rate imply $58 in service fees only, not their total payroll cost.
sections.zh: 当前价格页列出每员工每月起价 Global Payroll $29、EOR $599、美国 PEO $99；Contractor Management 每月每活跃承包人员 $29 起，Plus $99，Contractor of Record $325。这些是服务起价，不是员工工资、税或福利预算。Global Payroll、EOR、Management 说明平台包含且无基础费，FAQ 称无设置入门费。国家、所选服务、可选福利及实际发票币种仍需报价。两员工按 Global Payroll 公开起价仅为 $58 服务费，不是总工资成本。

sections.title_en: No standard deposit still permits a reserve
sections.title_zh: 无标准押金仍可能需准备金
sections.en: The FAQ says Remote does not charge a standard deposit, but can require a refundable reserve for potential employment obligations in certain circumstances, disclosed during onboarding. Unused funds may be credited or refunded subject to outstanding payments. That is working capital to budget even when not a fee. If billing and local payroll currencies differ, Remote says it sets and discloses one FX rate per billing cycle and holds it for that cycle. The benchmark or numeric margin was not independently verified; a fixed-cycle rate is not a claim that every currency conversion is free.
sections.zh: FAQ 称无标准押金，但特定情况下可为潜在雇佣义务要求可退准备金，并在入门时披露。未用资金可抵扣或退款，但受未清款项约束，虽非费用仍需预算资金。账单与本地工资币种不同时，Remote 称每计费周期设定披露一个固定汇率。未独立核实其基准或数值加点，周期固定不代表所有兑换免费。

sections.title_en: Read contractor indemnity as contract coverage
sections.title_zh: 把承包人员赔偿视为合同保障
sections.en: Management Plus advertises up to $100,000 per contractor, with a $1 million aggregate across all contractors over the entire term, for third-party claims arising from breach of Remote’s service warranty. That is qualified coverage, not a universal misclassification guarantee; Contractor of Record has a different contract. A startup discount is limited to eligible funding stages and the first twelve months. Remote may fit distributed employers wanting consolidated operations, but exact country/service terms, coverage exclusions, FX, banking, hosting, retention, exports and recovery remain unverified. Security badges and performance claims were not audited. No signup, contract, payroll, filing, AI action or transfer was executed.
sections.zh: Management Plus 宣传每承包人员最高 $100,000，整个合同期全部承包人员合计最高 $1,000,000，针对 Remote 违反服务保证引起的第三方索赔。这是有限保障，不是普遍分类保证，Contractor of Record 又有不同合同。初创折扣也限符合融资阶段及前十二个月。分布式雇主可评估 Remote 的集中运营，但国家服务条款、保障排除、汇率、银行、托管、保留、导出及恢复未核实；未审计安全标志及性能宣传，未注册签约、处理工资申报、AI 或转账。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
